Subject: Roadmap firebreaks & weekly sync — action roster (QBR prep)

Team —

Thanks for joining the QBR pre-brief with Acme earlier. A few cross-functional asks came out that are blocking the renewal conversation; I captured what I can below and flagged exec-level asks. Please review and update owners by EOD tomorrow.

Summary (high level)
- Acme needs a latency-stable variant for 3rd-party embeddings (their SLO: 150ms p95) — ask to prioritize a quantization + batching pilot on Dedicated.
- Procurement asked for a short SOC2 evidence bundle and a retention policy statement tailored for the account.
- They asked about rollout safety: want a canary timeline and rollback criteria before the pilot.

Action roster (initial)
1) Quantized pilot proposal (Dedicated) — owner: Marcus Lin — due: 2027-06-25 — deliverable: short plan with expected latency/cost delta.
2) Canary plan + rollback criteria — owner: Lauren Bishop — due: 2027-06-23 — deliverable: canary runbook and metrics thresholds.
3) SOC2 evidence subset & retention statement — owner: Olga Petrov — due: 2027-06-22 — deliverable: PDF bundle and one-page policy.
4) Commercial note for execs (recommended concession level if pilot fails) — owner: Rishi Malhotra — due: 2027-06-24 — deliverable: memo for GTM/Finance.
5) Dedicated capacity staging window — owner: Tessa Morgan — due: 2027-06-21 — deliverable: reserved slot and access list.

Attachments: qbr_action_tracker.xlsx (sheet with rows for each action)
Related links: consolidated tracker in Drive (see link below)

Next steps: please reply with one-line owner confirmations and any blockers. I will consolidate and send a short note to Acme by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

+1 on prioritizing the quant pilot for this account. Executive ask: if we cannot demonstrate the latency SLO within the pilot window, be prepared to offer a time-limited price credit (we discussed up to 10% as a conservative floor). Rishi — please draft the concession memo and include a couple of alternative mitigations (e.g., dedicated caching layer or shortened context windows for embeddings).

On the canary plan: we need clear rollback gates (error rate > 1% or p95 regression > 25% vs baseline) and a communication plan to Acme customer success if we hit those. Marcus — when you put together the perf table, include a column for sequence-length buckets (short/medium/long).

I started a skeleton canary runbook and attached it. I will refine the thresholds with Marcus tomorrow.

Attachment: canary_plan.md (runbook skeleton)
